title: NIRJALA introduces 3D Gaussian Splatting for water-free underwater reconstruction
summary: NIRJALA couples a three-path image formation model with forward scattering and physical priors to jointly reconstruct clean underwater scene appearance and geometry at 44 FPS.
research_notes:
Calibrate multi-view underwater camera images and estimate camera poses via structure-from-motion.

Initialize 3D Gaussians and fit the 10-parameter global physical water model alongside neural transmission parameters using the TRIVENI three-path formation model.

Optimize geometry and appearance with SAMARASA objectives, enforcing range-binned color priors to balance channel attenuation across distances.

Render novel views in real time with the estimated water medium inverted to produce medium-free imagery.

Constrain neural water field estimation with the PRATIBIMBA bidirectional physical anchor to prevent scene geometry from absorbing medium parameters.

Employ range-binned color balancing during optimization to address differential wavelength attenuation across depth intervals.
